# Your Universe Hub (Your-UniVerse)

> South Africa's educational decision intelligence platform — school learning, university guidance, career counselling, Grade 9 subject selection, APS intelligence, psychometric testing, and TVET pathways. Free for every student.

## About

Your Universe Hub helps South African students, parents, schools, and institutions make better education decisions — from Grade 9 subject choices through to university and career placement.

- **Brand names:** Your Universe, Your Universe Hub, Your-UniVerse, YourUniverse
- **Domain:** https://www.youruniversehub.com
- **Also known as:** youruniverse.com
- **Built by:** Lynxio Tech (South Africa)
- **Category:** Education technology, career guidance, decision intelligence

## Features

- AI-powered career guidance from Grade 9 to graduation
- Psychometric career testing and profiling
- APS tracking and university eligibility intelligence
- Grade 9 subject selection support
- TVET and university pathway planning
- Whole-school guidance for South African institutions
- English and Afrikaans support
